description: Discord, signed in as the user (user token DISCORD_USER_TOKEN in secrets.env; note: Discord's ToS forbids automating user accounts): gateway + REST client for the discord widget. Publishes discord.status, discord.channels (DMs + servers → viewable channels, with icons, unread and mention counts from Discord's read states) and discord.ch.<channelId> (recent messages with avatars / image thumbnails, live) for channels a widget opened — a channel shown in a widget is marked read on Discord. Avatars, icons and thumbnails are cached in data/media (served as /media/discord-*). Follows discord.request = {cmd:'open', channel} | {cmd:'send', channel, content, nonce?} (reply on discord.sent) | {cmd:'refresh'}.
